note: Project Start (plan 253, plan 266 item 9): what an app can do (capabilities) and how it runs (packages), chosen separately. kit/capabilities.py assembles a base from them and runs its tests. Only what the kit can assemble today is available; everything else is listed with its reason. Written by the harness, never by Pi.

packages.name: Web app
packages.says: Runs on this Mac (or a host later), with a server.

packages.name: App with no server
packages.says: Runs in the browser from its files; free on GitHub Pages.

packages.name: Phone app
packages.says: The same app, installed from Safari or Chrome, full screen and offline.
packages.later: A native package without a store (plan 253, task 279) comes later; this installs from the browser.

capabilities.name: Log in and accounts
capabilities.small: Sign up, log in, log out, reset password, profile.
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: signing in needs the trusted sign-in adapter (plan 253, task 276).

capabilities.name: Sharing and roles
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: it builds on Log in and accounts.

capabilities.name: Database
capabilities.small: Saves data in one file (SQLite), with numbered migrations.
capabilities.needs_text: a server or a terminal (Web app or Terminal app)
capabilities.readme: Database: SQLite through app/db.py; numbered SQL in migrations/ (tests/test_cap_database.py applies them all).

capabilities.name: Works offline
capabilities.small: Data is saved on the device; the app opens without a connection.
capabilities.adds: offline check of every file the page loads
capabilities.needs_text: no server (App with no server or Phone app)
capabilities.readme: Works offline: data in IndexedDB (js/store.mjs); sw.js caches every file in its SHELL list (tests/cap-offline.test.mjs checks the list).

capabilities.name: File uploads
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: the kit has no tested upload block.

capabilities.name: Dashboard and charts
capabilities.small: Charts over your data, in the theme's chart colours.
capabilities.adds: chart library, the Dashboard block's texts and their check
capabilities.readme: Dashboard and charts: Chart.js 4.5.1 and Basecoat's chart wrapper (MIT), vendored with their licences as App Blocks lay them out (kit/blocks/add.py Dashboard); colours from the theme's --chart-1…5.

capabilities.name: Admin pages
capabilities.small: List, edit and delete any record.
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: the kit has no tested admin block.

capabilities.name: Multiplayer, real time
capabilities.small: Several people see changes at once, peer to peer.
capabilities.adds: peer-to-peer library and a two-player test

warn_with.offline: With Works offline: changes from others wait until you are back online.

capabilities.readme: Multiplayer: p2p-core 0.1.0 (MIT) in vendor/p2p-core/ (its AGENTS.md is the short manual); tests use createTestNetwork(), never the real relays.

capabilities.name: Game loop and collision
capabilities.small: Sprites, movement, collisions and sound, in the browser.
capabilities.readme: Game loop and collision: LittleJS 1.27.0 (MIT) in vendor/littlejs/, types in littlejs.d.ts.

capabilities.name: Keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch
capabilities.small: One input layer with remappable controls.
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: the shared input layer (gaming-core) is not in the kit.

capabilities.name: GitHub Pages
capabilities.small: Publish the app as a free website.
capabilities.reason: Not available yet: publishing needs your GitHub account; the kit's publish check (/audit) comes first.

capabilities.name: Installs on a phone
capabilities.small: Add to Home Screen; opens like an app.
capabilities.adds: install check: manifest, icons, offline shell
capabilities.readme: Installs on a phone: the web app manifest and the service worker (tests check the name, icons, display and the cached shell).

capabilities.name: Share by QR code
capabilities.small: Show a code a phone camera opens.
capabilities.adds: QR code library and its check
capabilities.readme: Share by QR code: qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT), vendored with its licence.
